question: What should come in the place of blank number [1]?
solution:
The correct answer is '**reifies**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses the "logic of the archive" which "preserves through containment." This implies making something abstract into something concrete or fixed.
 
• The phrase "through its very naming" suggests a process where an abstract concept is turned into a "thing" or a static reality.
 
• "**Reifies**" (to treat an abstract concept as a concrete thing) fits perfectly here. By naming something in an archive, the system makes that identity "real" and fixed, which aligns with the themes of "containment" and "syntax of recognition."
 
• Other options ("**extinguishes**", "**evacuates**", "**dissimulates**") suggest removing, emptying, or hiding, which contradicts the idea of "preserving" and "naming" mentioned in the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

Complete Passage: *To speak of the political as an abstract structure is, perhaps, already to concede to the logic of the archive: that which preserves through containment, and 1. reifies__ through its very naming. The subject here is neither born nor made—but suspended, deferred in the machinic interplay of signifiers...*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Extinguishes (बुझा देना): To put an end to; while naming can limit, the archive's goal here is preservation, not total destruction.
 
• Evacuates (खाली करना): To remove the contents of; this would imply the naming makes the thing empty, which is the opposite of "reification."
 
• Dissimulates (ढोंग करना): To conceal one's thoughts or feelings; this refers to deception, whereas the text focuses on the structural power of classification.
